## Hello!

I’m a full-stack engineer with 3 years of experience building production systems for enterprise and government clients.

Currently pursuing an MSc in Business Analytics, I’m focused on bridging engineering with data-driven decision-making not just building systems, but understanding and influencing the outcomes they produce.

I enjoy working at the intersection of scalable applications and analytics, turning data into insights that drive real impact.
